plugin_layout.manifest: .zcode-plugin/plugin.json (ONLY required file; mcpServers declared here — design delta D1, no .mcp.json)
plugin_layout.hooks: hooks/hooks.json (auto-discovered; plugin enable state governs execution)

transition_rules: retry = a NEW attempt record on the same task (task status does not move backward); a full re-dispatch after terminal failure = a NEW task_id
every applied transition appends one event to .runtime/orchestrator_v3/events.jsonl (append-only, never rewritten)
every write goes through governance.atomic_io.atomic_write_json (validate -> tmp -> fsync -> rename -> read-back) with a CAS on the previous content sha256
handoff_rules: chat prose is advisory; the handoff JSON + git state are the only authority
a handoff whose dispatch_sha != actual_start_sha is INVALID (refused at validation)
validation re-measures git (commit exists, changed paths within allowed_paths) and test evidence; missing evidence is NOT_RUN, never inferred PASS

quant-explorer.notes: no edits, no Bash, no git mutation, no authority decisions; Explore does NOT inject AGENTS.md so its packet carries the boundary inline

quant-implementer.notes: one worktree, one ownership manifest, one focused commit; never merge/rebase/push/ledger/registry/other lanes; publishes structured handoff before return

quant-reproducer.notes: detached tree + frozen inputs only; cannot repair or reinterpret tolerances; emits ALL_MATCH|MISMATCH|NOT_RUN

quant-auditor.notes: fresh-context A7; reads frozen claim/evidence; writes audit namespace only; cannot fix code, weaken gates or select a convenient verdict

frontmatter_contract: camelCase, case-sensitive: name, description (required), tools, disallowedTools, maxTurns, model (omit = inherit), injectAgentsMd (default true), color

mcp_contract.transport: stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, declared under mcpServers in .zcode-plugin/plugin.json (D1)
rules: MCP never calls a model and never spawns ZCode agents; only the primary Lead invokes the Agent tool
wraps governance.atomic_io + governance.cycle_registry + governance.heavy_lock (never clones them)
missing/malformed runtime state is CONTROL_STATE_DRIFT, never an empty queue

hook_contract.protocol: one-line JSON on stdin; exit 0 = success (stdout JSON parsed); exit 2 = deny/block; other non-zero = recoverable failure; timeoutMs strict per hook
hook_contract.session_start: inject compact generated snapshot (cwd/branch/HEAD/dirty, canonical active cycles, heavy lock, pending handoffs, next ready task, S1/GO boundary); read-only; failure visible, never invents clean state
hook_contract.pre_tool: deny destructive/credential/S1/ledger/registry/push/main-merge patterns regardless of context; enforce allowed/forbidden paths only against the active dispatch context in .runtime/orchestrator_v3/current_dispatch.json; require ownership manifest before writable dispatch
hook_contract.post_agent: after an Agent/Task tool returns, verify the handoff artifact exists; missing handoff is injected as HANDOFF_INVALID, never inferred success
hook_contract.stop: if owned active tasks / unvalidated handoffs / unrun gates remain, decision:block with ONE compact next action; ZCode bounds continuation at 3 — durable recovery remains /lead-resume + task state

retry_policy: max_attempts default 3; a failed attempt appends an attempt record; no automatic infinite retry; TECHABORT after max_attempts
notification_boundaries: owner notified ONLY for: credential/account/license/purchase, S1/scored GO, push/main-merge/deploy, irreconcilable ownership choice, repeated blocker, terminal verdict
ordinary PASS/FAIL handoffs never require owner relay
install_boundary: single P5 stop point: ZCode UI requires the owner to add the Personal marketplace and click install/enable (enable = code-execution trust). No headless install exists (no zcode CLI on PATH); hand-editing ~/.zcode internal registries is forbidden.

canary_cases_frozen.P6: two parallel read-only explorer tasks on fixture paths; automatic return; combined report without owner relay
canary_cases_frozen.P7: two disjoint fixture worktrees, implementer dispatch, sequential integration, targeted tests
canary_cases_frozen.P8: reproducer then independent auditor; one deliberately bad handoff (dispatch_sha mismatch) must be REFUSED; valid handoff closes
